title: ‘They deserve to know the truth’: UN rights chief demands probe into staffer’s death in Houthi custody
keyFacts: The UN human rights chief on Saturday demanded an independent investigation into the death of a Yemeni colleague held by the Houthis for more than two years, whose family learned of his death only weeks after it happened.
